save.text: Sam absent; Scanlan will be run by Keyleth and Percy; Pike still in New York; Patrick Rothfuss (Kerrek) joining via Skype.
Lootcrate sponsorship returns: January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; URL lootcrate.com/criticalrole; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off first month.
Blue Microphones provided new equipment; Matt has long used Blue; site bluemic.com (B-L-U-E-M-I-C.com).
New store item: socks with 'How do you want to do this?' and logo; possible future Sox Machina; dice returning soon (this or next month); pins and bracelets limited stock back.
Convention: Anime Milwaukee Feb 17–19; attendees Matt, Marisha, Travis, Laura; Critical Role panel, signings; Patrick may try to meet (Wisconsin).

Recap: Raishan escaped Emon with Thordak’s corpse and two eggs; scrying located her on a southern island in the Lucidian Ocean (Thordak’s former lair; once Opash’s). Kerrek joined VM and is aiding the hunt.
Level-ups confirmed: Scanlan, Percy, and Pike leveled after Whitestone rest; full HP, half HD, spells recovered.
Attunement shuffle: Vax asked Vex to return his Boots; Vex agreed. Dragonkilling sword offered; Grog showed interest. New loot includes a Dwarven Thrower warhammer requiring attunement by a dwarf.

Attunement rulings: Dwarven Thrower usable if Belt of Dwarvenkind is attuned; losing belt forces losing hammer. Pike’s Boots of Elvenkind don’t require attunement; Sprinter’s Boots do; swapping in armor is slow. Vax attuned Deathwalker’s Ward to necrotic.

Weapons/attunements: Grog intends to attune Dwarven Thrower instead of Blood Axe; Thrower damage d8, range 20/60, can Reckless to offset disadvantage. Grog also holds the Dancing Sword (needs attunement).
Boots shuffle: Vex returns Vax’s Boots (reminded again); Vex plans to wear Pike’s new Boots of Elvenkind for now; Pike loses Sprinter’s Boots if swapping to Elvenkind.

Cursed sword event: Grog touched the scimitar; curse triggered, sword became inert; Grog now has permanent -2 to all saving throws unless removed by a god/Greater Restoration may help; Matt corrected prior card ruling.

Grog attunements/gear update: Still intends Dwarven Thrower over Blood Axe; Dancing Sword now inert after curse; declined Keyleth’s Ring of Protection +2 due to attunement; Pike plans to try Greater Restoration on Grog.
Rule clarifications: -2 to all saves is from curse (Deck card); permanent until divine-level removal; standard curse removal unclear; Matt corrected previous session misread.
Pike cast Greater Restoration on Grog at 5th level; did not remove his headache/curse effects.
Cloak of Displacement and Vax’s Ring of Invisibility loaned to Kerrek; ring makes wearer invisible until removed, attacking/casting, or bonus action to end.
Heroes’ Feast cast by Pike using diamond from hoard; effects: immune to fear/poison, +15 max HP to all (incl. Trinket, Allura, Kima, Kerrek); Wis save advantage.
Allura and Kima joined before/during Heroes’ Feast and ate; Allura geared up with rune-carved staff, rings, hooded ceremonial robes; face hardened.
Plan: Travel via Transport via Plants to Opash’s island instead of Allura’s 7th‑level Teleport to conserve resources.
Gate Stone left in Cassandra’s care; Kima took it to deliver to her before departure.
Kima accepted and donned Elven Boots from Vex to be quieter despite disliking style.
Travel executed: Keyleth cast Transport via Plants via Sun Tree to Island of Viscan near Opash’s mountain.
Allura confirmed scrying showed large trees near Opash’s lab on Island of Viscan; Keyleth targeted one for arrival.
Trees near Opash’s lab are long-dead/near-petrified for hundreds of years; not a recent effect; Keyleth confirmed via inspection; Matt clarified.
Stealth approach with Pass Without a Trace active; notable rolls: Keyleth nat 20, Allura nat 20, Percy 33, Scanlan 31, Pike 24, Kerr 24 after +10; Kima’s Elven Boots negated her disadvantage.
Allura’s research: Indigenous people once lived/traded here; after Opash arrived they vanished; island considered cursed; scavengers rarely return.
Allura: Gem in Thordak’s chest was created by her, Kima, and Drake; Raishan performed rituals to embed it on the Plane of Fire (per Allura/Matt, subject to belief).

Approach hazard: Multiple oval patches of unstable ground (“hollow earth”/magically eroded sinkhole zones) near mountain; identified by Vex, avoided by party; Keyleth Nature 22; Grog’s thrown rock later sank after briefly resting.
Vex (26) and Vax (18) scout ahead for traps; Vex spots subtle darker/damp sand patch before Vax steps in; more patches appear, denser nearer mountain base.
Mountain base: moderate-sized rocky mound ~600 ft tall; Vax Perception nat 20 (32), Vex 30 while scouting ahead.

Entrance blocked by 20–30 ft wide boulder jammed into cavern mouth; surface has many large claw-pierced holes; marks correspond to a very large dragon; boulder has been placed/removed many times over years.

Party plan debate: consider Stone Shape at seam to make narrow entry while leaving boulder to hinder escape; Vex suggests hole; Grog urges direct entry; perimeter scout would take 1.5–2 hours flying; talk of scrying before entry.
Vex used Primeval Awareness: sensed three dragon presences within 1 mile, below the mountain; eggs likely alive. Matt confirmed 1-mile (not favored terrain).
Plan resolved: party decides to go in now, stealthing; brief checks asked, then proceed despite risk.
Grog traded Deck of Many Things back to Vex for Periapt of Wound Closure; he promised not to draw or look, to keep it in pouch.
Trade resolved: Vex returned Deck of Many Things to Grog; he failed Perception (6) and promised not to look while she’s present; Grog took back the deck and Vex took the Periapt of Wound Closure.

Stone Shape used on boulder/wall: only creates a small opening; wall+stone thicker than 5 ft. Vex fired Oracle Arrow through; tunnel is dark, dusty, unused; about 100 ft in it curves left and descends.
Current plan discussion: small hole made; concerns about noise echoing to Raishan; option to spend another 4th-level Stone Shape vs. Grog brute force (siege gauntlets noted); stealth still a concern.

Debate on entry: option to use second Stone Shape would work (Matt), cost another 4th-level slot; alternative is leveraging boulder using hole and a long magical weapon; noise from Grog’s siege gauntlets still a concern.
Investigation: No switch found; there are dragon-sized fingerholds—boulder was jammed in place by something grabbing it.
Kima asked to use Holy Avenger as lever via hole; concern raised about damaging the sword; Matt/Kima: “You ding it, you pay.”

Team used Kima’s Holy Avenger as lever with Pike assisting Grog; Grog STR 23 opened gap ~1.5 ft; Immovable Rods wedged into finger-holes to hold boulder; each holds 8,000 lbs; boulder slowly moved then appeared stationary; party slipped through; Kima retrieved sword.
Party left two Immovable Rods wedging boulder; plan to retrieve later; discussed that it wedges shut against dragon, but Raishan could teleport or change shape.

Tunnel interior: 15 ft wide, 12 ft tall; dusty, smell of rot/stagnant water; carved purposefully; no airflow; floor peppered with scattered bone shards, many blackened/charred (recognized by Keyleth).
Keyleth Nature check 28: bone charring is years old at least; dust layer; not as ancient as trees near Opash. Matt confirmed.
Pike cast Death Ward (4th level) on Vex; lasts 8 hours; triggers to 1 HP at 0.
Party stealth checks: Vex 30, Vax 35, Percy 34, Keyleth 30, Grog 30, Pike 25, Scanlan 18, Kerrek 29. Proceeding down mildly descending curving tunnel.
Tunnel shelves/alcoves every ~20 ft: melted candle clusters; skull with more candles; small books and a small wooden box (untrapped per Vax 22); a mummified raccoon-like creature propped up.

Light/darkvision: Vax’s flaming dagger sheds candle-level light; with dagger out he can see decently to 60 ft; without it he sees poorly to ~15 ft; investigation for traps not at disadvantage with dagger light.
Party proceeding stealthy in dark by linking arms; brief light from Vax’s flaming dagger then likely put out on request to keep dark.
Kerrek used Divine Sense; initially Matt said only vague undead presence, then corrected: type/location sensed unless behind total cover; detected an undead presence to the party’s left on a wall.

Undead source likely the candle/skull shelf to the left; Grog (darkvision via Belt of Dwarvenkind) approached and retrieved a dust-covered, singed human skull with two melted candles; handed it to Kerrek.
Vax investigated further (25): no trap; tunnel shows remnants of ancient stonework; Vax plans to stay on natural/ruined sections over constructed areas.
Kerrek’s Divine Sense confirmed the human skull is the undead source; not reacting while held. Skull bagged in burlap and set back on shelf facing wall; not destroyed.
Marching order set: Twins front; then Grog & Kerrek; then Keyleth & Percy; then Kash/Scanlan; rear are Kima & Allura with Trinket out, watching behind.

New chamber: hexagonal with a large iron door sealing progress; central dark green marble pillar with bolted rough iron bowl at chest height on a dais; to the right a shelf with a very large leather-bound tome and a cold iron brazier with dried tinder (unburnt).

Hex room clarified: entry is open; a large smooth-seamed iron door blocks the far side; center dais has iron bowl atop pillar; right wall has a brazier with dried tinder and a large unlabeled leather tome.
Bowl residue scraped to dark burgundy powder with iron taste—identified as long-dried blood. Likely blood-activation mechanism considered by party.
Keyleth lit flame hands to illuminate; no ceiling gaps or visible levers/panels; room appears ancient stonework with some cave-ins; door shows no mechanical attachments (likely magical if it moves).
Leather tome by brazier: not trapped; text becomes unreadable—shrinks/obscures under any attempt; brighter light makes pages go near-blank; idea proposed to read in darkness/low light.
Hex room contents reaffirmed: entry open; far side large smooth-seamed iron door; center dais with iron bowl; right wall brazier with dried tinder and large leather tome (now on floor, opened).
Kerrek’s hammer emits radiant light forming the head; brightens room; mustiness recedes; under this light the tome’s text shrinks to dots/blank.
Kerrek’s hammer light off made text slightly more legible but still blurred; bright light returns room illumination.
Brazier trap exploded when lit; Keyleth and Kerrek failed/failed+made saves: K&K took 32 fire, others nearby 16 (Vax evaded); book destroyed—purpose was trap trigger per Allura.
Bowl tests: basilisk blood poured—no effect; Vex then cut her hand to drip her own blood.
Hex room door opened when Vex dripped her blood into bowl already containing basilisk blood; basilisk blood sizzled to edges; Vex took 1 dmg; shaking/dust as metallic door lifted.

Pike cast Holy Aura (8th) on party: 30-ft radius around her; allies get advantage on saves; enemies have disadvantage to hit; fiends/undead melee attackers must CON save or be blinded; emits small light on each.

Encounter: four flame skulls approached from both hallway directions after door opened; laughter heard; initiative rolled; top: Scanlan 22 (nat 20), Keyleth 22 (nat 20), Vax 21, Percy 17, Vex 16, Grog 14.

Initiative segment: Scanlan and Vax acted first; Scanlan cast Invisibility (2nd level) and moved to northern wall; Vax flew 10 ft up to opposite wall and hit a flame skull twice (Whisper + venom dagger) for 19 total; both attacks hit (AC ≤15).
Keyleth cast Moonbeam (concentration, 5-ft radius) positioned to hit two flame skulls; both failed CON saves (16,13) and each took 13 radiant; the one Vax hit is badly flickering but still aloft.
Party formation: Group circled around Pike at chamber center; four flame skulls approaching from both sides after gate lifted; no one is on the flying carpet.
Flame skulls each cast Fireball simultaneously at clustered party; DC 13 DEX saves with advantage from Holy Aura; Scanlan excluded (invisible away).

Damage results: On save, 56 fire total; fail two -> 88; Vax evaded all (0). Percy, Vex, Kerrek saved all (56). Grog failed two (88). Keyleth saved all (56, to 50 HP). Pike failed two but has fire resist: 44. Trinket only saved one and was stored in necklace.
Matt corrected mid-resolution: initial numbers (e.g., 72/76) adjusted; finalized totals per above; Pike explicitly has fire resistance.

Kerrek’s Aura of Protection grants +3 to nearby allies’ saving throws; retroactively applied: Pike reduced her fire damage by 11; Grog’s two 10s became 13s so he saved all, total 56 fire instead of 88; Trinket still failed three even with +3.
Percy (Animus) used Sharpshooter/Deadeye to kill two flame skulls; regained grit on each kill; repositioned by running up the wall to perch at an angle.
